name: AI-Integrated RFQ Intake, Direct DXF Preflight & Verified Screening Reports
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.1.1 integrates AI Engineer (Chat, Command Palette, Local Engineer & Design Review) directly with Single-Part RFQ Intake Screening and Direct DXF Preflight, keeping CAD geometry 100% offline on your PC.

highlights.title: Single-Part RFQ Intake Screening & AI Engineer Integration
highlights.text: Compute PCA Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) stock envelopes alongside AABB, verify watertight volume and mass (withheld instead of 0 when unverified), summarize STEP AP242 PMI, track Customer PDFs separately, copy free clarification questions, or run RFQ screening directly from AI Engineer Chat and Command Palette.

highlights.title: Direct DXF Preflight in Waterjet 2D Studio
highlights.text: Inspect uploaded R12–R2018 ASCII DXFs with unitless/$INSUNITS conflict gating, side-by-side mm vs. inch bounds, unsupported entity blocking, Origin (0,0) & 1:1 extents, and explicit Overkill diff approval before clean-copy export — plus live DXF Preflight telemetry shared with AI Engineer.

highlights.title: Shared p3dw.finding/1 Contract & HTML Review Packets
highlights.text: Every RFQ and DXF preflight finding records explicit status, method, unit basis, and parser coverage inside self-contained Pro HTML Review & Screening Reports.

highlights.title: 15-Day Pro Trial, Free Basic 3D Viewer & SolidWorks / NX Native Bridge
highlights.text: Full 15-day no-card Pro trial unlocking PDF/DXF waterjet exports, bundled local SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM) & Siemens NX (.prt) setup, 4-GiB OCCT kernel, AP242 PMI, 1D Tolerance Stack-Up, and GPU photoreal renders — falling back cleanly to Free Basic 3D Viewing & RFQ screening forever.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake screening, DXF preflight, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md.
Native SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM) and Siemens NX (.prt) viewing via NVIDIA usd-convert-cad 0.3.0 installs locally only after explicit operator I ACCEPT license consent.
